Clara (Growth): Planning a 25-minute micro-webinar focused on inference cost wins for APAC. Need a final run-of-show, speaker order, and lead routing. Quick ideas?
Noah - Events: Keep it tight. 2x8min demos, 4m panel/Q&A, 2m intro, 3m close = 25m. We'll require recorded fallbacks for both demos.
Isha (Design): Can do a 1-slide-per-demo prompt and a 6-slide master. Will add speaker notes for handoff.
Darren (Eng Ops): Registration fields: deployment_interest (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), monthly_inference_spend (buckets). Tag SFDC leads with campaign=micro_apac_2026.
Clara (Growth): Also capture workload_type hidden param (chat/summarize/embeddings). SDRs can filter.
Darren (Eng Ops): For routing: Zapier -> SFDC -> #sales-inbox. High-value leads (>$5k) trigger immediate Slack ping to APAC_SDRs.
Noah - Events: Rehearsals: full dress 48h prior (30m) and tech check 15m prior. CueBot can post T-48h and T-15m reminders.
CueBot: Scheduled cues: T-48h rehearse, T-15m mic check, T-10m switch to speaker view, T-2m start recording, T+1m post survey link.
Isha (Design): Need 40-50 word bios and a 90s recorded fallback clip per speaker.
Clara (Growth): Speakers confirmed: Mira (Platform PM), Sean (Customer), Akiko (Infra). I'll draft registration copy: "25 minutes: practical steps to cut inference cost without trading latency."
Darren (Eng Ops): SLA: SDR assignment within 12h for >$5k leads, otherwise 48h. I'll upload the mapping doc after this thread.
Noah - Events: I'll pin the run-of-show in Drive and send calendar invites. Rehearsal slots: Thu 02:00 UTC, Fri 09:00 UTC. Please RSVP.
Clara (Growth): Owners recap: Noah (events/greenroom), Darren (lead routing + SLA), Isha (slides), Clara (moderator + copy). Thanks team!
